headline: Major Issuers Oppose OKX-ICE Tokenized Stock Trading Venue Under SEC Rules
summary: Microsoft, Alphabet, Goldman Sachs and other major issuers have objected to being listed on a planned tokenized stock trading venue by OKX and Intercontinental Exchange.
why: Tokenization bridges traditional equities and blockchain infrastructure, drawing regulatory and corporate scrutiny over compliance and control.

impacts.name: Crypto Exchange
impacts.why: Corporate pushback against tokenized stock offerings creates uncertainty for exchanges attempting to bridge traditional equities and blockchain.
